sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
A supplier audit result does not grant a part approval.
l'audit riguarda il fornitore, non le singole parti

findings.why: The only approval for BR-220 is Alluminio B at TO1 for STL. Meccanica C has no BR-220 approval. Its approvals AP-0207 are for BR-180 only. Passing the audit and the end of probation do not give a part approval. PRC-DEV-007 adds that a temporary deviation does not approve a new material source.

sources.quote: billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.
APPROVAL AP-0207: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri); billet grade EN AW-6061-T6

findings.why: The approved BR-220 billet is EN AW-6082-T6 (drawing Rev C). The email gives 6061-T6, and 6061-T6 is the grade Meccanica C is approved for on BR-180. The email is informal and conflicts with the controlled approval record. It does not replace the drawing, so the 6061-T6 billet does not meet the grade the drawing in force requires.

The 5 Nov email says 8D-25-031 is still open after the audit. It appears in the context of Meccanica C. The documents do not state the alloy or material the 8D covers, so a person should confirm that it concerns the aluminium billet before this is treated as final.
